svg.text: Flywheel next — one data plane of declared state, one control plane contract, and a profile is how an organization hosts it
signals → intents → claims → verdicts → bolts → as-built · a red dot is a decision that reaches the operator as a plan decision · storage and coordination sit under the contract
SOURCES · what could change a decision
the plan · the operator's decisions, now
one response · applied once · the decision retracts
status view · a projection, never truth
queued · in progress · waiting · done · per host
moves · one standing move per signal
design book · chapter and claims, one source
prose · diagram · sample · claim by anchor
only standing claims are planned against
bolt type · the sequence of actions
every git operation is an engine effect
session · one job, one place, fixed exits
in: instruction · skill · work order · change
out: done · question · finding · chore · stalled
CONTROL PLANE CONTRACT · the data plane's only exit
seven operations · a machine names evidence abstractly · the binding maps names to storage
TRACKER PROFILE · the tracker is central
state: an item per object · milestones · board
response: a reply, or a move on the item
board fields are projections, never read
GIT-ONLY PROFILE · the git host is central
state: files · a landed commit is the fact
response: one writer turns a reply into a commit
CUSTOM PROFILE · any storage, fully bound
state: yours · every evidence name bound
response: a transport the profile names
a plan decision is created here
the data plane never names a label, a file, or a service · a profile is a binding of seven operations, and Parts A and B do not change to admit one
